note: The subdivision $v Conversation and phrase books (for homeowners) was added to the H 1154 list of free-floating subdivisions under languages.

If a specific [...] influences subdivision has been established under a heading, it may be used with geographic subdivision interposed (e.g. Architecture--Spain--American influences) without a new authority record.

Dialects with names based on place names are not established as headings of their own; the usual practice is [language]--Dialects--[place], e.g. French language--Dialects--Channel Islands--Jersey rather than Jerriais language.
The subdivision $x Health was added to the H 1120 list for families.
The subdivision $x Silica content (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.
Refugees is qualified only by adjectives for non-national ethnic groups; national groups are brought out by geographic subdivision (Refugees--Cuba), so Refugees, Cuban was not approved.

The string --Salaries, etc.--Law and legislation (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1100 pattern list for classes of persons, so e.g. Primary school teachers--Salaries, etc.--Law and legislation needs no proposal.
The subdivision $x Privatization (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1153 list for industries.
The subdivision --Protestant churches may be used as a free-floating subdivision within the category of Christian denominations, e.g. Homosexuality--Religious aspects--Protestant churches.
The subdivision --Marriage customs and rites is free-floating under ethnic groups, so Santal (South Asian people)--Marriage customs and rites needs no proposal.
The subdivision --Violence against is free-floating under classes of persons, so Women--Violence against needs no proposal.
The subdivision $v Film and video adaptations was added to the H 1155.8 list for literary works entered under title.
The subdivision $x Pollination (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.
The subdivision --18th century is free-floating under headings for literatures and genres of those literatures (H 1156), so Ladino poetry--18th century needs no proposal.
The subdivision $x State supervision was made (May Subd Geog) on the H 1095 and H 1153 lists.

subdivisions: --Conversation and phrase books for first responders
note: The subdivision $v Conversation and phrase books for first responders was added to the H 1154 list for languages.
Establishing --Legal status, laws, etc. (Canon law) as a free-floating subdivision was not approved because it is so rarely needed; it should be established under individual headings as needed.
Strings made of a main heading with subdivisions followed by 'in art' or 'in literature' are not used in LCSH; assign separate headings for the components (e.g. Ukraine--In art, Famines in art).
The subdivision $x Fieldwork (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1095 list.
The subdivision $x Field work was deleted from the H 1095 list, replaced by --Fieldwork.

The subdivision $x Hybridization (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.
The subdivision $x Undergraduates was added to the H 1151 list for individual schools.
The subdivision $x Dosimetric treatment (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1150 list for diseases.

The free-floating subdivision --Influence was extended to literary, artistic and moving image works entered under title (H 1155.8). It was judged undesirable to extend --Appreciation to titles of individual motion pictures.
The subdivision $x Expansion and contraction (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1158 list for materials.
It was judged undesirable to precoordinate a corporate body with --Radio broadcasting of performances; assign separate existing headings instead.
The subdivision $x Stability was added to the H 1149 list for chemicals.

Subdivisions of the type --Effect of [...] on have not been combined with headings for endogenous chemicals, and LC declined to start the practice; assign the chemical heading together with headings for the activity or process (e.g. Exercise--Physiological aspects).
LC did not consider it desirable to divide Rome--Religion by time periods, so Rome--Religion--Republic, 510-30 B.C. was not approved.
The string $x Authorship $v Style manuals was added to the H 1095 list for use under disciplines.

The subdivisions $x Spores (May Subd Geog) and $x Spores $x Morphology were added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.

The subdivision --Treatment is free-floating under diseases and other medical conditions including wounds and injuries (H 1150); bites and stings count as wounds, so Snakebites--Treatment needs no proposal.

The heading for comic books and mass media was changed to Comic books, strips, etc.--Influence on mass media, which also covers graphic novels, so no separate heading for Graphic novels and mass media was approved.
The subdivision $x East Indian authors was added to the H 1156 list for literatures.
The string $x Seeds $x Climatic factors was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.
Biographies of members of a political party are represented by the heading for the party with the subdivision --Biography, not by a heading for the individual's faction (Maximalists).
Continental shelf may be subdivided geographically, so the proposed Continental shelf--North Atlantic Ocean and --Nova Scotia strings were not necessary.
Geomorphology may be subdivided geographically, so the correct string is Geomorphology--Australia--Great Barrier Reef (Qld.), not Great Barrier Reef (Qld.)--Geomorphology.
The subdivision $x Abrasion resistance (May Subd Geog) was added to the H 1158 list for materials.

Headings of the type [entity A]-[entity B] relations are established only when the two entities are separate and unrelated; Police-government relations was not approved because the police are an agency of government.
Civil defense drills--Theatrical techniques was judged excessively specific for LCSH; Civil defense drills is sufficiently specific.
LC felt it undesirable to establish --Law and legislation under a type of legislative body such as Zemstvos.

There is no precedent for subdivisions for specific categories of diseases under individual plants; use --Diseases and pests plus an added heading for the disease type (Corn--Diseases and pests; Virus diseases of plants). Corn--Virus diseases was not approved.
Subdivisions listed in H 1200 may not be used under War on Terrorism, 2001- unless explicitly established under it, because 'war' is used metaphorically in the heading.
The string $x Embryos $x Motility was added to the H 1147 list for animals.
Methods (Salsa), Methods (Salsa)--Group instruction, Methods (Salsa)--Self-instruction and Studies and exercises (Salsa) were added as $v subdivisions to the H 1161 list for musical instruments.

Because Music--Arab influences is established, the geographic subdivision may be interposed (Music--Algeria--Arab influences) without a new authority record.
The subdivision $x Radioactive contamination was added to the H 1147 list for animals.

A chronological subdivision such as --History--1526-1919 must be a generally recognized period (H 620 sec. 3.d(2)) and its dates should coincide with the beginning or ending dates of adjacent periods rather than overlap them (sec. 3.d(3)).
The subdivision $x Telephone calls was added to the H 1100 (classes of persons), H 1103 (ethnic groups), H 1110 (individual persons) and H 1120 (families) lists.
The subdivision $x Properties was added to the H 1149 list for chemicals.

Headings for Palestinian Arab literature are constructed from the heading for Arabic literature with geographic subdivision for Palestine, e.g. Prisoners' writings, Arabic--Palestine, rather than with a Palestinian Arab qualifier.

The subdivision --Social aspects has traditionally not been used under Crime because the heading is inherently a social science topic; --Social aspects and --Sociological aspects are distinct, so Crime--Sociological aspects does not take the UF Crime--Social aspects.
The subdivision $x Robots was added to the H 1159 list for military services.
The subdivision $x Vertical distribution was added to the H 1180 list for plants and crops.
Headings of the form [Topic A] and [Topic B] are established only when a work discusses the relationship of the topics from both perspectives in very broad terms (H 310).
Shinto--Charities is a free-floating combination authorized by the pattern list under religions (H 1185), so no proposal is needed.
Headings of the type [...] in old age have been established only for diseases or psychological topics or conditions, not for general activities; Authorship in old age was not approved.
